title: Two Koreas clash at UN over DMZ mine blasts

blocks.text: South and North Korea clashed at the United Nations last Thursday over recent land mine explosions in the Demilitarized Zone, with Seoul accusing Pyongyang of violating the Armistice Agreement and demanding an apology while the North denies responsibility. South Korean Ambassador to the UN Cha Ji-hoon raised the Sept. 21 explosions during the general debate
